sentence: Evidence from UK firms points the same way: AI adoption raises innovation performance only where it complements what the firm itself invests in R&D, and it partly substitutes collaboration with external knowledge partners
passage: [D'Amico et al. (2025), abstract] "Our findings suggest that firms adopting AI can enhance their innovation performance if it complements firm's own investment in R&D. AI adoption can substitute knowledge collaboration with certain external partners."

gemini.overclaim: Evidence from UK firms, only where
gemini.note: The passage does not mention UK firms and states the condition for enhancing performance as 'if' rather than the more restrictive 'only where'.
